sources.review: Primary survey describes four-sided obelisk with vertical Luxor lettering, carved patterns, statuary and pedestrian tunnel below; separate northern pylon sign must not be confused with it.
East face visually inspected. Pale tapered shaft, stepped plinth, dense shallow carved glyphs; no Luxor word on this face. Base above sidewalk appears solid; tunnel elevation unresolved.
Secondary source search result lists Luxor Hotel obelisk140ft/43m. Needs height corroboration; mappedheight62 and roofheight70 conflict.
North face inspected: vertical blue/gold lettering and repeated five relief figures on pedestal; apex outside frame.
Aerial inspected: north/south pedestrian axis through base; road east and parking west.
Secondary photographer caption corroborates 140ft/43m; not a primary measured survey.

remaining: 42.672m overall height follows published 140ft, not survey.
Pedestrian tunnel floor and 2.68m clearance are inferred; no measured section.
Original glyph patterns and base figures approximate ornament; not a transcription or scan.
